description.value: The Mex is a well-established neighborhood pub in Courtenay, BC, proudly serving the community for over 20 years from its location at the bottom of Ryan Road near Superstore. It offers a lively entertainment program of live bands, DJ nights, and weekly karaoke, alongside a full pub menu of wings, ribs, burgers, and shareable platters. A Beer & Wine store operates directly next door, making it a convenient one-stop for an evening wind-down on a touring route through the Comox Valley.
